profile: gradient descent: an extremely popular local optimization algorithm that determines high quality descent directions. It is based on the first-order Taylor series approximation to a function. The algorithm uses a simple update step, employing the negative gradient as the descent direction. It is applied to minimize the Least Squares cost.
